venice-planters: The name suits a planter — Venice grows greenery wherever it can, on balconies, bridges and rooftops.
malta-planters: Malta is one of the sunniest places on Earth — over 300 sunny days a year. A fitting name for outdoor planters.
tokyo-high-planters: Tall planters lift plants to eye level — the oldest interior-designer trick for making a corner feel finished.
tokyo-dual-tone: Dual-tone planters catch light differently on each shade — a quick trick that adds depth to a plain corner.
quebec-rectangle-planters: Rectangle planters double as room dividers — a row of them creates a living wall between two spaces.
cubo-planter: 'Cubo' is Spanish for cube — cubic planters stack and pack neatly, which is why nurseries ship them happily.
milano-short-stone-finish-planter: Stone-finish planters give the look of carved stone without the weight — or the cracking in cold weather.
grow-it-yourself-giy-microgreens-kit-san: Microgreens are ready in 7–10 days and can carry far more nutrients by weight than the same plant grown to full size.
grow-it-yourself-giy-microgreens-kit-noo: Noodle-mix greens are chosen for stems and crunch — they hold their bite in hot food where soft leaves would wilt.
grow-it-yourself-giy-microgreens-kit-sal: Microgreens were once only restaurant garnish — now the fastest thing you can grow at home, from tray to plate in a fortnight.
flora-diet-flowering-booster-ready-to-us: Flowering boosters are rich in phosphorus and potassium — the two nutrients plants burn through fastest when blooming.
flora-diet-flowering-plant-food-slow-rel: Slow-release granules feed a little at a time for weeks — a drip of nutrition instead of a feast-and-famine cycle.
root-ease: Rooting promoters mimic auxins — the plant's own hormones that signal a cutting to grow its first roots.
aqua-green-diet-water-plant-food: Aquatic plants feed through both leaves and water, so pond food is made to dissolve slowly without fouling the water.
green-diet-complete-plant-food-slow-rele: Complete plant food is a full meal — nitrogen for leaves, phosphorus for roots, potassium for flowers and overall strength.
